Every startup we covered this week 👇

• Agent37 (YC F26) launches low-cost sandboxes for running AI agents
• Loops raises $3.5M from a16z speedrun to build an AI OS for commerce
• Consus (YC F24) launches an AI gateway for companies with sensitive data
• Two IIT-Delhi grads gave up ₹1.3 crore in salaries — their YC startup just raised $1M
• This a16z speedrun startup gives factories an AI sales rep — and just raised $9.8M
• a16z just cut most of the team that helps its startups hire people
• This YC startup wants an AI agent watching every customer — critics call it surveillance
• Koch just backed this a16z startup whose AI agents help sell industrial materials
• This a16z-backed startup automates billing for businesses — and Intuit is buying it
• Pear VC raises a $333M Fund V to find founders before the market does
• This Techstars startup just raised $3.4M to take on healthcare's paperwork problem
• Stanford told them the market was too small. Their Techstars startup just raised $7M
• WindBorne wins a $49M US Air Force contract for its weather balloon data
• YC-backed Clueso raises $10M for AI video creation
• This startup wants AI to run the boring back office of medical clinics — and just raised $12.5M
• A teenager built a calorie app to $30M+ in revenue — by paying an army of influencers
• This startup grows mini human intestines to test drugs — and just won $100,000
• Mark Wahlberg is opening a gym with cold plunges and blood tests — without the luxury price
• A 24-year-old braider is building a machine that cuts hours of braiding prep

Save this, and follow @moonshotdaily for YC, a16z and SF startup news every day.
